'''Athal-Je''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] in training. Athal-Je was among the candidates [[Sophia Farash]] identified to the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] who was on [[Voss]] looking for an ally. Farash stated that Athal-Je was gifted, but didn't study much.<ref name="A Thorny Path" />
